code: import axios from'axios';let heartbeatInterval=null;export function startHeartbeat(token){if(heartbeatInterval)return;heartbeatInterval=setInterval(async()=>{try{await axios.post('http://localhost:5000/api/admin/heartbeat',{},{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}});console.log('💓 Heartbeat sent');}catch(error){console.error('Heartbeat error:',error);}},5000);}export function stopHeartbeat(){if(heartbeatInterval){clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);heartbeatInterval=null;console.log('💓 Heartbeat stopped');}}
